name: Freddie
summary: A doomsday prepper with a fenced compound on Lake Leonida, played by the rapper Freddie Gibbs.
body: The official credits list "Freddie" as played by Freddie Gibbs.
His compound is on the north shore of Lake Leonida, in North Leonard County; VGC's guide covers breaking in.

GTA Scoop says you break in once, then a few in-game days later Freddie texts a rematch, Retest Freddie's Defenses, which brings a hurricane and unlocks hurricane weather. Either lead can do it in any chapter, and it counts toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy.
GTABase lists Freddie's Dubsta, a Benefactor kept in his bunker, which can be taken and registered.

name: Alvan West
summary: The man behind the Kelly County Tip Line, who turns out to be the killer in the Missing Persons side quest.
body: Played by David Beach, per the official credits.
Output Lag spells his name "Alvin Weston"; this page uses the credits' spelling.

name: Kent Paul
summary: The fast-talking Londoner from Vice City and San Andreas, back for a cameo inside the Vice City easter egg.
body: Danny Dyer plays him again, as in the earlier games.
He waits in the easter egg's PS2-style area and phones the player after they leave.
